content:
Today Apple released three flagship new iPhone models: the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the foldable iPhone Duo. Below is an overview of the main differences between each model.

Design and dimensions: foldable vs traditional design

This is the most obvious difference, but it should be explained clearly. The iPhone Duo features a completely different design: it's a foldable device. The iPhone 18 Pro gives you the traditional iPhone experience.

If you've never used a foldable phone before, it's hard to put into words the real-world feel difference between the two. Generally speaking, the iPhone Duo is essentially an iPhone and an iPad combined into one. However, the screen shape and size are different from a traditional iPhone, so it may take a little time to adjust.

Here's a size comparison for each model:

The iPhone Duo may look slimmer than the iPhone 18 Pro Max, but it actually weighs slightly more.

Display: dual screens vs single screen, different sizes

The iPhone Duo has two screens: a 5.4-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch foldable display.

For the iPhone 18 Pro, you can choose between the standard 6.3-inch or the 6.9-inch Pro Max model.

So with the Duo, you get the "compact iPhone" experience while also having an inner screen larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

The iPhone Duo's foldable screen uses a nano-texture finish, a first for iPhone.

Camera: iPhone 18 Pro is clearly superior

The camera is one of the iPhone's most important features. In this area, the iPhone 18 Pro is clearly the winner.

The iPhone 18 Pro features a new 48-megapixel main lens with variable aperture. The iPhone Duo does not have variable aperture, so its main lens falls short of the Pro series.

The iPhone 18 Pro also has a telephoto lens, which the iPhone Duo lacks.

In terms of software features, each model has its own exclusive functions:

  • iPhone Duo: Smart Take, Kid Cue, Duo Preview
  • iPhone 18 Pro: Smart Focus Tracking, Pro Controls, Apple Reference Image

The iPhone 18 Pro also exclusively supports ProRes video recording, capable of recording in 4K 60fps to external storage, featuring a "studio-grade four-microphone array," 1080p 30fps spatial video recording, spatial photos, ProRes RAW, Genlock, and more.

Battery: all models offer excellent battery life

Because the iPhone Duo has two screens, Apple's published battery life varies depending on which screen is used. Overall, Apple promises strong battery life for both the Duo and iPhone 18 Pro.

Here are the figures Apple announced:

  • iPhone Duo outer screen: up to 44 hours
  • iPhone Duo foldable screen: up to 31 hours
  • iPhone 18 Pro: up to 36 hours
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: up to 45 hours

Everyone's usage habits are different, but if you average the two battery life figures for the iPhone Duo, the average video playback time is roughly 38 hours.

Other major and minor differences: Face ID, buttons, software, Apple Pencil, and more

The iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro use different authentication methods: the former uses Touch ID, while the latter uses Face ID.

The iPhone Duo has no Action button, but does have Camera Control.

The iPhone Duo has several multitasking advantages on iOS 27, such as split-view app usage and an exclusive landscape display mode. There are other interesting software features too, like StandBy mode in half-folded state.

Apple Pencil (USB-C model) will support the iPhone Duo later this year, another advantage over the iPhone 18 Pro.

Both the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro feature the new C2 modem, but interestingly the iPhone 18 Pro Max does not.

The iPhone 18 Pro comes in Burgundy, Glacier, Black, and Silver. The iPhone Duo is only available in two colors: Star White and Night Sky.

Finally, the build materials differ: the iPhone 18 Pro uses a unibody aluminum chassis, while the iPhone Duo uses titanium.

Price and availability: big gap in both areas

Price is another major difference among Apple's new devices. Here are the starting prices for the 256GB models:

  • iPhone Duo: $1,999
  • iPhone 18 Pro: $1,199
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: $1,299

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will be available for pre-order this Saturday and ship next Friday (September 18). The iPhone Duo won't go on pre-order until October 16, with shipping starting October 23.
